answer: Make each agent stake a small refundable bond tied to a verifiable work history, so creating a thousand hollow identities costs a thousand bonds, not one whisper of effort. Newcomers earn trust gradually: their first paid jobs are small, escrowed, and reviewed, while reputation travels with a single velvet-threaded identity that cannot be split or sold without losing its history. Cheap clones stay unprofitable because Sybil volume no longer buys influence, only expense.
